SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM KEPTRXL WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'RE' GROUP BY DOC_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'PSAN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, 1 AS SEQ, 'C' AS STATUS, ISNULL(B.QUOTATION_NO,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, ISNULL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, ISNULL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(B.TARGET_PRICE,0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(B.ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(B.RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(B.DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(B.SPECIFICATION, ' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(B.UNIT_MEASURE, ' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM KEPTRXL A, KEP_RE_V B WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND A.KEY_1 = B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PSAN' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, 0 AS SEQ, 'D' AS STATUS, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS QUOTATION_SEQ, KEY_2 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 0 AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, 0 AS ITEM_QTY, ' ' AS ADD_DATE, ' ' AS RD_DATE, ' ' AS DESCRIPTION, ' ' AS SPECIFICATION, ' ' AS UNIT_MEASURE FROM KEPTRXL A WHERE A.DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' ) WHERE SEQ = (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(T.QUOTATION_NO)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM KEP_RE_V T WHERE T.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND T.BUYER_ITEM_NO = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$') ORDER BY QUOTATION_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO
DELETE KEPTRXL WHERE 1=1 AND DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$'
